attempted_axis: Remove game/g3d/auxanim's five own-pool UND ghosts by spelling the pool literals, and recover the .sdata2 pool ORDER (not just its contents) by converting the ghosts in the order MWCC creates constants.

attributes.axis_log: A1 convert lbl_803459E0 only -> real 114, pool 56B but 255.0 landed at 0x18 (wrong): the other f64 slots were still externs and did not claim their positions. A2 also convert D0/D8 -> pool order correct through 0x18, 255.0/1.0 still swapped at 0x20/0x28, real 126. A3 swap the multiply operands to `255.0 * (f32)(1.0 - k)` -> IDENTICAL result to A2 (real 126, same pool order): the multiply-operand-order hypothesis for MWCC pool creation order is REFUTED, axis dead by the two-identical-A/B rule. A4 split into two statements `k = (f32)(1.0 - k);` then `k * 255.0` -> pool BYTE-EXACT, real 118. A5 use a fresh temp `kf` instead of reassigning k -> identical to A4 (real 118), so the temp-vs-reassign axis is also dead; kept A5 because it does not clobber k. A6 convert the last two f32 ghosts B8/BC including the volatile read -> FREE (real still 118, pool still exact, all ghosts gone). CONCLUSION ON MWCC POOL ORDER: creation order follows STATEMENT order, not operand order within one expression - a constant used only inside a larger expression can be created after a constant that appears later in that expression, and splitting the statement is what fixes the sequence.
